source_text: I'm sorry, I've misjudged you.

text: 我很抱歉，我错怪你了。
source_text: 我很抱歉，我错怪你了。

text: You should have just killed the brat!
source_text: You should have just killed the brat!

text: 你该杀了那个小混蛋！
source_text: 你该杀了那个小混蛋！

text: Well, maybe you could be just a little nicer to him.  I think he's trying.
source_text: Well, maybe you could be just a little nicer to him.  I think he's trying.

text: 嗯，那你也许能对他稍微和气一点。我想他在努力改正了。
source_text: 嗯，那你也许能对他稍微和气一点。我想他在努力改正了。

text: You should give him a good whipping!
source_text: You should give him a good whipping!

text: 你该赏他一顿鞭子！
source_text: 你该赏他一顿鞭子！

text: Ya' think killing people solves the real problem?
source_text: Ya' think killing people solves the real problem?

text: 你认为杀人就能解决问题了？
source_text: 你认为杀人就能解决问题了？

text: Yep!
source_text: Yep!

text: 没错！
source_text: 没错！

text: It's been working for me so far!
source_text: It's been working for me so far!

text: 这对我来说一直很有效！
source_text: 这对我来说一直很有效！

text: Hmmm, maybe not.
source_text: Hmmm, maybe not.

text: 唔，也许不是哦。
source_text: 唔，也许不是哦。

text: I don't know.
source_text: I don't know.

text: 我不知道。
source_text: 我不知道。

text: You disappoint me. You seemed to have a good head on your shoulders.# Killing them might get rid of the problem temporarily, but you've got to# get at the root of the problem to really make a difference.
source_text:
You disappoint me. You seemed to have a good head on your shoulders.
# Killing them might get rid of the problem temporarily, but you've got to
# get at the root of the problem to really make a difference.

text: 你让我失望了。你肩膀上的脑袋看上去倒是挺聪明。杀人，也许可以解决一时的问题，但是却让这个问题从本质上变得完全不同了。
source_text: 你让我失望了。你肩膀上的脑袋看上去倒是挺聪明。杀人，也许可以解决一时的问题，但是却让这个问题从本质上变得完全不同了。

text: Yeah, whatever.
source_text: Yeah, whatever.

text: 是啊，随便啦。
source_text: 是啊，随便啦。

text: Uh, okay. Bye.
source_text: Uh, okay. Bye.

text: 呃，好。拜拜。
source_text: 呃，好。拜拜。

text: You're an idiot.
source_text: You're an idiot.

text: 你这个白痴。
source_text: 你这个白痴。

text: Well (he pauses looking off into space) . . . maybe yer right, partner. # I'll keep that in mind but I ain't promisin' ya' anything.
source_text:
Well (he pauses looking off into space) . . . maybe yer right, partner.
 # I'll keep that in mind but I ain't promisin' ya' anything.

text: 嗯，【他停下来往四周看了看】……也许你是对的，伙计。我会考虑的，但是我不敢保证。
source_text: 嗯，【他停下来往四周看了看】……也许你是对的，伙计。我会考虑的，但是我不敢保证。

text: Are ya' kiddin'? That'd just make'm more defiant! My ways may not be # perfect but at least I know it'll make'm stronger and more responsible.
source_text:
Are ya' kiddin'? That'd just make'm more defiant! My ways may not be
 # perfect but at least I know it'll make'm stronger and more responsible.

text: 你在开玩笑吧？那只会让我更加目空一切！我的方法或许不是最好的，但至少这可以让我变得更强，更有责任感。
source_text: 你在开玩笑吧？那只会让我更加目空一切！我的方法或许不是最好的，但至少这可以让我变得更强，更有责任感。

text: Damn straight. Kill'n the person with the disease isn't the best way. # You've gotta find the cure because it's bound to surface again.
source_text:
Damn straight. Kill'n the person with the disease isn't the best way.
 # You've gotta find the cure because it's bound to surface again.

text: 该死，把得病的人杀了不是最好的办法。你肯定能找到治好他们的方法，因为它就要再次出现了。
source_text: 该死，把得病的人杀了不是最好的办法。你肯定能找到治好他们的方法，因为它就要再次出现了。

text: No kidding, Einstein.
source_text: No kidding, Einstein.

text: 别开玩笑了，你以为你是爱因斯坦啊。
source_text: 别开玩笑了，你以为你是爱因斯坦啊。

text: Quit yer' yappin'! You're giving me a headache!
source_text: Quit yer' yappin'! You're giving me a headache!

text: 少废话了，我头都疼了！
source_text: 少废话了，我头都疼了！

text: Uh, yeah, sure pal. I've gotta go.
source_text: Uh, yeah, sure pal. I've gotta go.

text: 呃，是啊，没错，伙计。我得走了。
source_text: 呃，是啊，没错，伙计。我得走了。

text: Well, try not ta solve all yer problems with a gun. Bye.
source_text: Well, try not ta solve all yer problems with a gun. Bye.

text: 嗯，别总用枪解决问题。再见。
source_text: 嗯，别总用枪解决问题。再见。

text: Damn, it's hot today!
source_text: Damn, it's hot today!

text: 妈的，真热！
source_text: 妈的，真热！

text: Billy! Ya' better not be screw'n around, ya' little shit!
source_text: Billy! Ya' better not be screw'n around, ya' little shit!

text: 比利！别在那游手好闲的，你这个垃圾！
source_text: 比利！别在那游手好闲的，你这个垃圾！

text: Billy! Ya' better make sure those brahmin are kept warm tonight or# it'll be yer hide!
source_text:
Billy! Ya' better make sure those brahmin are kept warm tonight or
# it'll be yer hide!

text: 比利！你今晚最好让那些双头牛保持温暖，不然剥了你的皮！
source_text: 比利！你今晚最好让那些双头牛保持温暖，不然剥了你的皮！

text: Damn it, you little brat! Stop yappin' and start working!
source_text: Damn it, you little brat! Stop yappin' and start working!

text: 该死，你这个小混蛋！闭上你的狗嘴干活去！
source_text: 该死，你这个小混蛋！闭上你的狗嘴干活去！

text: I told you to stop screwing around!
source_text: I told you to stop screwing around!

text: 我跟你说了，不要游手好闲的！
source_text: 我跟你说了，不要游手好闲的！

text: I'm warning you, Billy!
source_text: I'm warning you, Billy!

text: 我警告你，比利！
source_text: 我警告你，比利！

text: You don't want the hard way, do you?
source_text: You don't want the hard way, do you?

text: 你不是敬酒不吃吃罚酒吧？
source_text: 你不是敬酒不吃吃罚酒吧？

text: Sorry kid, can't talk. I've got a business to run.
source_text: Sorry kid, can't talk. I've got a business to run.

text: 抱歉，小子，我现在不能跟你掰，我得干活去了。
source_text: 抱歉，小子，我现在不能跟你掰，我得干活去了。

text: Sorry, can't talk. I've got a business to run.
source_text: Sorry, can't talk. I've got a business to run.

text: 抱歉，我现在不能跟你扯淡，我得干活去了。
source_text: 抱歉，我现在不能跟你扯淡，我得干活去了。

text: You'd better not be pester'n Billy; he's got a hell of a lot of work# to do today.
source_text:
You'd better not be pester'n Billy; he's got a hell of a lot of work
# to do today.

text: 你最好别烦比利了，他今天有一大堆事要做。
source_text: 你最好别烦比利了，他今天有一大堆事要做。

text: Beat it, I'm busy.
source_text: Beat it, I'm busy.

text: 走开，我忙着呢。
source_text: 走开，我忙着呢。

text: Why are people always bother'n me?  Can't you see I'm work'n?
source_text: Why are people always bother'n me?  Can't you see I'm work'n?

text: 为啥每个人都来烦我？你们没看到我正在忙吗？
source_text: 为啥每个人都来烦我？你们没看到我正在忙吗？

text: Talk to the Merchants if you want a job. I'm not hiring.
source_text: Talk to the Merchants if you want a job. I'm not hiring.

text: 要工作的话跟那些商人说。我这里不招人。
source_text: 要工作的话跟那些商人说。我这里不招人。

text: Why don't ya' go play in the Maltese Falcon? I'm busy.
source_text: Why don't ya' go play in the Maltese Falcon? I'm busy.

text: 你干嘛不去“马耳他猎鹰”那儿玩玩啊，我忙着呢。
source_text: 你干嘛不去“马耳他猎鹰”那儿玩玩啊，我忙着呢。

text: What the hell are you doing here?  Get out!
source_text: What the hell are you doing here?  Get out!

text: 你到底要干嘛？滚！
source_text: 你到底要干嘛？滚！

text: I said get out! I'm not joke'n!  I'll blow yer frigg'n head off!
source_text: I said get out! I'm not joke'n!  I'll blow yer frigg'n head off!

text: 我说了，滚！我不是在开玩笑！我他妈要剁了你！
source_text: 我说了，滚！我不是在开玩笑！我他妈要剁了你！

text: Ya' punks will never learn, will ya'?
source_text: Ya' punks will never learn, will ya'?

text: 你们这些小流氓永远都不懂，是吧！
source_text: 你们这些小流氓永远都不懂，是吧！
